en.title: Counting Triplets (Sum Divisible by d)
en.description:
Given an integer array, count the triplets with strictly increasing indices whose three values sum to a multiple of d.

This site uses a standard input/output protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n d; the second line contains n integers. 3≤n≤1000, 1≤arr[i]≤10^9, 2≤d≤10^6.
en.output: Output the number of qualifying index triplets.
en.explanation: Count the first two positions by remainder; modulo d, the third remainder is then uniquely determined. Use combinatorial counting to exclude repeated indices.
